items.q: What if I forget my master password?
items.a: Your vault is encrypted with it, so we cannot recover it. Emergency access lets a trusted contact help you back in.
No. Passwords are encrypted on your device before they are stored. Only you hold the key.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Apps are available for iOS and Android, with autofill in browsers and apps.
Passkeys replace passwords with a secure key on your device. Keyhaven stores and syncs them like passwords.

items.q: Can I import passwords from my browser?
items.a: Yes. Import from Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge in a few clicks.
Share a login with a person or a group. They can use it without seeing it, and you can revoke access anytime.

items.q: What happens if a password leaks?
items.a: You get a warning with the site and the date, plus a one click generator to replace it.
Yes. Cancel from billing settings. Your vault stays readable on the free plan.
